summary: SK Telecom Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of a share exchange under Korean law, making SK Broadband its wholly-owned subsidiary. The exchange paid cash consideration of KRW 15,032 per SK Broadband common share. SK Telecom's board resolved March 26, 2026, executed the agreement March 27, and closed May 29, 2026. SK Telecom was already the 99.24% majority owner before the exchange, taking full ownership after. No new shares were issued; cash was paid to dissenting shareholders, who had appraisal rights through May 18. The deal is a squeeze-out at a fixed price. Watch for any court challenges to the appraisal price by dissenting SK Broadband shareholders, though the filing notes such petitions do not halt closing.
